verdict: Round 7 is sound as built: every point holds by my own measurement, with three caveats. (1) The published intent text of shield_absorb_1 s27 says it was 'chosen as the most typical candidate', but screen.json marks it pressedNoiseFallback (the only non-cut-off file left, over both notSaturatedNoise numbers). (2) By my own shot counter thruster_three s21 and s22 also hold three shots, so the 'second slot empty' and '3 of 16 files have three shots' statements hold only by count_shots. (3) The shield_snap s22 pick has a transient in the raw file at 0.53 s that the page check lists as a file click. Nothing in the repository was changed by this check except this report. Nothing was listened to; no statement here says how any sound sounds.

The rule is declared only for the three generated shield families, so only absorb breaks a rule. Why 'partly': (a) absorb s27 is published although it is over both numbers (a fallback, see mustFix). (b) The page check lists a click in the snap pick: the raw file has a transient of about plus/minus 0.05 at 0.531 s where the local rms is 0.005 (about 20 dB above), the published step is 0.0265 against a median step of 0.00085 in that region (about 31 times). From the 50 ms level traces s21 and s22 are dense 2-second blocks, so I do not claim they have three separate shots, but 'exactly three shots' and 'slot 2 empty' rest on count_shots alone.
